subject: Next steps: Exec sponsor briefing + steering committee scheduling for NordBank
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Müller <sarah.muller@nordbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: quick recap + proposal for exec briefing and steering committee

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call: 
- Scope: Evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) for NordBank fraud-detection model serving (low-latency, data residency in EU).
- Key concerns: SOC 2 evidence, in-country data residency, procurement timeline, and executive sponsor alignment.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency SLOs, cost per 1M tokens, contract flexibility for on-prem/pilot, and KMS integration.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 30–45 min exec sponsor briefing (we'll bring the product brief + SLA commitments).
2) Convene a 60 min steering committee meeting (legal/procurement/infra/business stakeholders) to review risk/mitigation and a mutual action plan.
3) Share a short security package and a draft MAP for procurement.

I've looped in Rishi (account lead) and Rafael (solutions engineering) — they'll cover pricing bands and technical attachments respectively. If you can confirm the exec sponsor and a couple windows for the steering committee, we'll send an agenda and pre-reads.

Attachments: reference doc list will be shared in the next email (short PDF + MAP stub).

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

[Redwood Inference]

Soojin —

Thanks for the recap and helpful framing. I spoke to our CTO and Legal; they'd like the following added to the thread: Devon Clark (Head of InfoSec) and our Procurement lead Tom Becker. Looping them in now.

Executive sponsor will be Marcus Linde, EVP of Platform (he's available next Tue/Wed mornings CET). For the steering committee, we typically include: Marcus (exec sponsor), Devon (infosec), Tom (procurement), Lina Sørensen (Data Privacy), and one representative from Ops (I can confirm).

Could you provide: 
- A 1‑page exec brief tailored to Marcus (concise SLAs, top-line procurement ask).
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 summary + network diagram + KMS integration note.
- A short mutual action plan (timeline + owner table).

If you can send the above by Monday, I can propose committee times by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks — Sarah

Hi Sarah, Devon, Tom —

Great to meet you all (virtually) — welcome to the thread. Per Sarah's ask, attached are the items for the committee and Marcus's briefing:
- Attachment: NordBank-ExecBrief-Redwood-1page.pdf (1 page: TL;DR of value, SLA bullets, ask)
- Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (summary + contact for full SOC2 report)
- Attachment: NordBank-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, timeline, owners)

Practical notes on stakeholders and owners (proposal):
- Exec sponsor: Marcus Linde (decision authority), primary comms via Sarah
- InfoSec lead: Devon Clark (security gating + evidence)
- Procurement: Tom Becker (contracting, procurement slate)
- Technical champion: Lina Sørensen (data privacy) — Sarah to confirm
- Account lead: Rishi Malhotra (commercial/final approval)
- SE/Technical POC: Rafael Mendes (SRE & integration plan)

Suggested agendas:
- Exec briefing (30 min): 10 min value + risks, 10 min SLA/contract ask, 10 min Q&A (Marcus-focused)
- Steering committee (60 min): 15 min recap & timelines, 20 min security/procurement deep-dive, 15 min integration plan, 10 min decisions & owners

Rishi
- I propose a pricing band for the pilot (regional dedicated capacity + transfer) — we can present ranges rather than a final quote in the committee to avoid procurement slowing things down.

Rafael
- I'll bring a short integration checklist and timeline for the KV cache, KMS, and logging/audit hooks.

Can you confirm Marcus' morning availability windows next Tue/Wed CET and whether Lina will join the committee? Once we have two preferred blocks I'll book the meetings and send calendar invites + pre-reads.

Best,

--

Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick recap + proposal for exec briefing and steering committee

Thanks team — quick commercial note so the committee has context: 
- Pilot structure we recommend: 3-month dedicated EU capacity + 1 month trial for up to 20k qps tokens/month.
- Expected cost band (ballpark): EUR 18k–32k / month depending on quantization profile and caching; final quote after technical scoping.
- Procurement points: standard T&Cs + data residency addendum; we typically accept NordBank's redline process but will ask for a 45–60 day review window.

I'll prepare a 1-slide pricing band to appear in the exec brief and bring a short note on commercial milestones (purchase order, billing cadence).

If the committee prefers precise numbers prior to the meeting, let me know — otherwise we'll present ranges and a next-step commercial checkpoint.

—Rishi

Soojin / Rishi —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Marcus confirmed Tue 21 Apr 09:30–10:00 CET as the exec slot and Wed 22 Apr 10:00–11:00 CET for the steering committee. Lina will join the steering call.

A couple of security-specific asks prior to the committee:
1) Full SOC 2 report (if possible) or an NDA-protected share; if not, the SOC 2 point-of-contact to request it.
2) Network diagram showing peering and ingress/egress flow for the VPC deployment you propose.
3) KMS integration note: whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys and which KMS providers (we use Azure Key Vault).
4) Retention and audit-log retention windows (we need >= 1 year audit logs).

If you can either attach these or point to a secure Doc/HubSpot link prior to Tue morning, we'll be able to review with Marcus.

Thanks — Devon
Head of Information Security | NordBank
